it hurts me to leave a negative review for warframe.
i got banned from this game about 2 years ago and somehow this game was so good that i played all the way back to where i had been banned and then some. 
back then, new updates were all about cool new game mechanics that felt good to use and could actually be useful in game, complimenting the warframes incredible movement system, but since that point, the warframe team has tried as hard as it possibly can to reinvent the game. they have tried 3 times and im tired of learning a new game every time just so i can get back to playing the old game again because the new one sucks ass.
1. archwing, this one was the very first reinvent, and it was kind of cool that you could go into water, but since nobody played it, nobody actually had good archwings, and since nobody had good archcwings, nobody wanted to play it.
2. railjack, this was the first sign something was wrong. railjack is almost an entirely different game to warframe, because there is absolutely no integration with railjack to the rest of the game, it feels like a standalone expansion, you are either playing railjack or you are playing warframe, there is no crossover of progress, resources are entirely different.
3. necramechs, these things feel like straight ass to control, i was so excited for the new open world because it might finally bring me back to the game, but as soon as i started playing with the necramech i realised they were just trying to reinvent the game for no reason again. these things feel like you are piloting a cardboard box that makes your screen shake, they are strangely agile while still having the worlds worst weightyness, and the guns do ♥♥♥♥ all for damage because i dont want to play as this thing any longer than i have to.
4. operators, this is the best reinvention by far, since its not a reinvention. it actually compliments warframes, and you use both operators and warframes in tandem, since both have their uses, and you can swap between them easily (as long as youre host), they werent trying to replace warframes by introducing operators, they were trying to add another layer onto existing systems, which is the kind of content i feel like most of the warframe community wants.
